name: IntelliTeX (CodeT5+ 220M T5), greedy English-to-LaTeX
summary: LatexGen's plain-English-to-LaTeX specialist: a T5 encoder-decoder (12+12 layers, d_model 768, 12 heads × 64, vocab 32100) as static WebNN graphs. Three encoder/decode-step pairs, one per input-length bucket (32/64/128). A tokenised prompt goes in; greedy token ids come out.

encoder.model: T5Stack, 12 layers, d_model 768, 12 heads × 64, d_ff 3072 ReLU, RMSNorm eps 1e-6, relative attention bias 32 buckets / max distance 128, bidirectional
encoder.role: token encoder; hoists decoder EncDecAttention K/V

decoder.model: T5Stack, 12 layers, causal self-attention, cross-attention over the encoder, tied lm_head
decoder.role: autoregressive LaTeX token decoder, one step per dispatch, cache 256

source.precision: float16 constants; RMSNorm variance in float32. Greedy tokens identical to fp32 Hugging Face on 15/15 LatexGen items.

encoder32.role: T5 encoder, static padded length 32, plus hoisted decoder EncDecAttention K/V

input_ids.source: T5 SentencePiece ids of the LatexGen prefix plus the user's text, padded to L with pad id 0

pad_bias.source: fp16 additive bias: 0 on real tokens, -1e4 on pad; write the same tensor into the matching decode graph

chaining.contexts: ONE MLContext per length bucket. Compiling three decode graphs in one context kills Chrome; a consumer (and scripts/verify.mjs) builds one encoder+decode pair at a time, on a fresh page or a fresh context.
pattern: 1. Pick the smallest bucket L that fits the padded prompt length (32, 64, or 128).
2. writeTensor(input_ids) and writeTensor(pad_bias) on the encoder; write the same pad_bias into the decode graph.
3. Allocate TWO sets of the 24 self-attention cache tensors (A and B). Zero set A.
4. dispatch(encoder). No await: dispatch is ordered on one pipe. The 24 K/V outputs are the decode graph's decN_k / decN_v inputs (chain links).

5. tok = 0 (decoder_start), step = 0. Loop: writeTensor(tok), writeTensor(step); dispatch(decode, caches from A, {token_out, caches into B}); await readTensor(token_out); append; stop on eos 2 or step 256; else tok = that token, step++, swap A and B.

autoregressive.note: runtime/loader.js autoregressive() implements the loop from these fields once `graph` is rewritten to the bucket's decode graph. k=1 (token_out shape [1]).

chaining.everyOutputMustBeBound: WebNN requires every declared output to be bound at dispatch. Cache outputs are the second tensor set.

tokenizer.algorithm: T5 SentencePiece / Hugging Face tokenizers.json Unigram, 32100 entries. Encoding stays the consumer's transformers.js (or equivalent) T5 tokenizer; this family ships the files so a consumer can load the same vocab. Verification is token-id identity, not string decode.
tokenizer.produces: encoderL.input_ids (padded). decodeL.token_out is what it would DECODE.
tokenizer.parity: 15/15 greedy token sequences match fp32 Hugging Face generate() after stripping the leading decoder_start 0 (webnn-workbench bench/results/webnn-intellitex-e2e-pass2.json)

constants.note: Each encoder/decode pair has its own recorded blob. Encoder blobs differ by the baked length-L relative bias; decode blobs are the same weights with encoder-side K/V input shapes baked per L. A future v2 can share one canonical blob.

verification.case: LatexGen's 15 text-to-LaTeX items (public/bench.html / bench/judge.py), prefix 'Convert natural-language math into a STRICT LaTeX equation\n', greedy, max_new_tokens 256
verification.reference: fp32 Hugging Face generate() on duanxianpi/IntelliTex (export_intellitex.py)
verification.bar: greedy token ids identical to the reference on every item (leading decoder_start 0 stripped); encoder K/V max abs within 2× the fp16 floor
verification.runner: scripts/verify.mjs --entry intellitex-t5-220m/<id>  (fresh page per length bucket)

notes: Pass one matched step 0 on every item and then drifted: the baked decoder rel-bias is HF layout [1, heads, query, key]; gather must use axis 2. A reshape to [N, heads, N] is not a transpose. RMSNorm variance is a float32 island because a naive fp16 sum-of-squares of 1403×768 overflows.
